tasks.title: Cross-cutting verification (inventory, new classes, sink failure, slow, behavior unchanged)
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/logging_coverage/ tests/property/logging_coverage/ tests/unit/logging_coverage/ -v
implementation_steps: Verify the normative inventory (spec §3.1) covers every public class and module function.
Verify new public classes are traced by default (forward-looking policy, AGENTS.md).
Verify a log sink failure does not interrupt the traced call (REQ-013).
Verify a traced call exceeding its slow_threshold_ms logs a WARNING and is not interrupted (REQ-014).
Verify tracing does not change public API signatures or observable behavior (REQ-016).
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/logging_coverage/ tests/property/logging_coverage/ tests/unit/logging_coverage/ -v
design_constraints: Tracing is observability only — it must not change behavior (REQ-016, NFR-004).
Tracing is best-effort and non-blocking (REQ-013, REQ-014, INV-004).
The slow threshold is observability, not enforcement (ADR-033).
completion_gates: The inventory covers every public class and module function.
New public classes are traced by default.
A log sink failure does not interrupt the traced call.
A slow call logs a WARNING and is not interrupted.
Tracing does not change public API signatures or observable behavior.
